candidates.name: Coastal ADS Inc (Coastal A.D.S., Inc.)
candidates.reason: Local commercial acoustical and hollow-metal-door subcontractor in business since 1976. Its Chamber profile, as quoted in search results, says it sells, installs and maintains toilet accessories for commercial and industrial buildings. I couldn't open the Chamber page (503 and cert errors), so I never saw toilet partitions named on a page I read.
candidates.partition_evidence: Only from search-result summaries of its Corpus Christi Chamber profile: it installs 'toilet accessories' alongside acoustic ceilings and hollow metal doors. A second search summary mentioned a Chamber firm offering 'toilet partition and accessory installation', which is probably this one but isn't confirmed.
red_flags: Chamber profile could not be read directly; partition work unconfirmed
Main lines appear to be acoustical ceilings and hollow metal doors

license.name: Coastal ADS Inc (Coastal A.D.S., Inc.)
license.registry: City of Corpus Christi Development Services STAR Contractor search (contractorrating.apps1.corpuschristitx.gov)
license.note: Checked 2026-11-19. Corpus Christi's STAR registration (Bronze, Silver, Gold) is voluntary. City Information Bulletin IB016 (11 Nov 2024) says 'This is a voluntary program, and contractors are not required to participate' (https://www.corpuschristitx.gov/media/vtiajsfh/ib016-contractor-registration-program-031425-updated.pdf). The STAR search tool at https://contractorrating.apps1.corpuschristitx.gov/ is a JavaScript app. Its static page holds no records, and automated querying of its data was not permitted in this session, so Coastal ADS's STAR status is unchecked. Look up 'Coastal' by hand in a browser, and ask Development Services what registration applies to commercial permits.

candidates.name: DEA Specialties Co., Inc.
candidates.reason: A capable commercial installer: Bobrick's case study names it the installing distributor for 380 Bobrick stalls at the San Antonio convention center. However, it is based in San Antonio, about 140 miles from Corpus Christi (beyond the 120-mile limit), and neither its homepage nor its contact page mentions Corpus Christi or South Texas coverage. It would be worth revisiting if it confirms it serves Corpus Christi.
candidates.partition_evidence: Bobrick case study PDF: 'Installing Distributor: DEA Specialties'; 380 stalls and 66 urinal screens installed (Bobrick SierraSeries). The website lists 'Partitions & Accessories' under Products.
red_flags: Sells and distributes partitions itself (buy-around risk)
Outside the 120-mile radius with no stated Corpus Christi coverage
Offices only in San Antonio and Austin

candidates.name: Bernco Group, LLC

Converse is near San Antonio, about 140 miles from Corpus Christi. I found no website, no project photos and no stated Corpus Christi coverage.
candidates.partition_evidence: govconinabox listing: 'Division 10 specialty subcontractor'; keywords include toilet partitions and toilet compartments.

candidates.name: One Point Partitions
candidates.reason: An online partition seller, and therefore a competitor rather than an installer. Search snippets say it delivers to Corpus Christi from a delivery terminal and that its experts help with design, ordering and delivery. Its site returned 403 to every fetch, so I saw no installation service. Its base location is unknown; within_area is set to 'no' only because the schema has no 'unknown' option.
candidates.partition_evidence: None seen. Snippets describe it as a seller of powder-coated and stainless partitions with delivery to Corpus Christi.

candidates.reason: The only trace is a Thumbtack profile that came back empty when fetched. A search snippet says it does Division 10 work and has 2 years in business, but I couldn't verify that. It is San Antonio based (about 140 miles away) and has no website.
